label.administrable_evidence: Applicant organizations applying for tracks other than product testing must be accredited to ISO 17025 or have a quality system that ensures quality assurance and quality control of laboratory testing including but not limited to: validated methods, document control, training programs, and analyst competency requirements.

alignment_dhhs.rationale: The opportunity aims to enhance the capacity and capabilities of state laboratories, which aligns with the objective to invest in the capacity of partners to overcome health disparities.

alignment_dmva.rationale: The opportunity does not directly relate to any DMVA strategic plan objectives.
